Team,

Quick nudge on the MedTech portfolio ahead of the Q4 forecast close. Finance needs clean stage and close-date data in Salesforce so our committed numbers are accurate for the October 22 review. Please action the items below by EOD Tuesday (10/19):

1) MedTech - Integration Suite (SF opp 0061M00000XYZabc)
   - Current stage: Proposal
   - Current close date: 2027-11-30
   - Ask: Confirm whether this is moving into Commit. If not, move to Best Case or archive as stale. If yes, update close date to the realistic negotiated date and set probability accordingly.

2) MedTech - Analytics Pilot (opp created 2027-06-15) — stale activity (no update in 45+ days)
   - Ask: Either archive / convert to nurture, or requalify with expected close date.

3) All MedTech opps marked "Forecast": make sure Stage/Close/NextStep fields are populated. If you do not have recent customer confirmation, tag the record with "needs-reconfirm" and add a 1-line reason in the NextStep field.

Attachments: Ive attached the latest SOW (SOW_v2.pdf) for context on deliverables and billing milestones that impact revenue recognition.

Why this matters: Forecast integrity drives our capacity planning for Dedicated nodes and affects billing accruals. The FP&A review on 10/22 will lock numbers for the month, so missing or stale dates will skew the commit.

If you need me to surface any specific opps in the forecast workbook, call out which ones and Ill include them in the Q4 packet.

Thanks —
